journal_lines: §aRed dust in the deepslate. §oA faint crackle when the pick touched it.§o §lRedstone§l vein, decent size.
§aCrackled when I struck it. Crackled less as it came out. Redstone.
§aGlow from inside the stone before I opened it. §lRedstone§l, warm and restless.
§aDust hummed in the bag on the way back. Quiet, but steady.
§aThe deepslate here has a faint charge to it. §oFur stood up a little when I pressed close.§o Redstone behind the wall.
§aRed light steady in the crack, like something holding its breath. Opened it. Took it.
§aFine red powder, then larger chunks further in. §lRedstone§l seam going deep.
§aStruck the wall and the dust that came off glowed for a moment. Good vein.
§aTook the whole seam. §oThe bag buzzed faintly for an hour after.§o Interesting ore.
§aWorked it slowly. Redstone doesn't like to be rushed out of the rock.
§aSeven good chunks before the vein thinned. §lRedstone§l. Worth the depth.
§aFound it low in the wall. Dug parallel and found more. Wide deposit down here.
